findings.description: The separator condition in get_help_spec was inverted during the move: it now uses "; " when any_prefix_is_slash is false and " / " when it is true. The original code had the opposite mapping, so the help spelling for every option changes.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with ordinary prefixes, such as --verbose with -v, where any_prefix_is_slash is False. The original code joined the spellings with " / " in that case, and the new code joins them with "; ". Slash-prefixed options are also flipped. The left column of every option's help record in --help output therefore changes text, which is user-visible and breaks any tooling that parses it.
